predeclared_analysis.primary_fit_region: |z|>=20 for outer hypothesis; retain all-four fits as sensitivity check, never delete16
predeclared_analysis.score: abs(observed-predicted)/observed for each sign; report every M1-M4 residual
predeclared_analysis.empirical_screen: residual <= max(0.02,10*observed adjacent-level relative rho discrepancy). This is a diagnostic, not a confidence interval or certified error bound.
predeclared_analysis.exponent_stability_screen: report p from20..32 and20..48; empirical class near2 requires abs(p-2)<=0.05 and abs(delta_p)<=0.05; no p confidence interval from deterministic four radii
predeclared_analysis.symmetry: score negative and positive independently; neither may be reused from the other
predeclared_analysis.followup_decision: If near-R^-2 class predicts48 within empirical screen, freeze refit and propose off-grid±44 as new holdout; if all models miss or exponent unstable, diagnose matrices/qualification first and only then propose±64 as different-regime discriminator.
predeclared_analysis.budget_separation: No automatic second pair. Every followup requires separately fixed predictions, source, ceiling and new authorization.
predeclared_analysis.empirical_G03_closure_candidate: Only after accepted outer48 plus heldout44, stability under exclusion16 and pairwise resolution checks; identify an empirical predictive class, not unique coefficients. If multiple models indistinguishable retain that limitation.
predeclared_analysis.continuous_claims: None; successful heldout fits do not close G04 orG05.
